SELECT 
    "School Code",
    "School Name",
    "Enrollment (K-12)",
    "Free Meal Count (K-12)",
    ("Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)") AS FreeMealPercentage
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
    AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
    AND ("Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18;

    "District Name",
    "County Name",

SELECT 
    CDSCode, 
    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    PovertyLevel,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS EnrollmentRank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode, 
        "Enrollment (K-12)", 
        "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
        CASE 
            WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
            WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium-High Poverty'
            WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" BETWEEN 25 AND 50 THEN 'Medium-Low Poverty'
            ELSE 'Low Poverty'
        END AS PovertyLevel
    FROM frpm
    WHERE CDSCode IN ('39685850122580', '39685930126094')
) AS ranked_schools;

        s.County,
        sc.sname AS School,
        sc.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank

        s.Virtual = 'F'

) AS ranked_schools

SELECT 
    School
FROM 
    (
        WITH ranked_schools AS (
            SELECT 
                sc.sname AS School,
                s.County,
                sc.AvgScrRead,
                RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank
            FROM 
                satscores AS sc
            JOIN 
                schools AS s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
            WHERE 
                s.Virtual = 'F'
                AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT 
            School,
            County,
            AvgScrRead
        FROM 
            ranked_schools
        WHERE 
            rank = 1
    )
ORDER BY 
    AvgScrRead DESC;

SELECT 
    f.CDSCode, 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    CASE 
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium-High Poverty'
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" BETWEEN 25 AND 50 THEN 'Medium-Low Poverty'
        ELSE 'Low Poverty'
    END AS PovertyLevel,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS EnrollmentRank
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'San Joaquin' AND s.Virtual = 'P' AND s.Charter = 1;

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrRead AS SAT_Reading_Score,
    s.AvgScrMath AS SAT_Math_Score,
    s.AvgScrWrite AS SAT_Writing_Score,
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS Total_SAT_Score,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPM_Eligibility_Rate,
    (s.NumTstTakr * 100.0 / s.enroll12) AS Test_Participation_Rate,
    s.AvgScrWrite - d.AvgDistrictWriteScore AS Writing_Score_District_Difference
FROM 
    satscores s
JOIN 
    (SELECT AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS AvgDistrictWriteScore FROM satscores WHERE dname = 'Clovis Unified') d
ON TRUE
JOIN 
    frpm f ON f."School Code" = '1030501'
WHERE 
    s.cds = '10621171030501';

        frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

        AND s.Charter = 1 
        AND s.County = 'San Joaquin') ss
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores sat ON ss.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY 
    ss."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC;

WITH FreeMealData AS (
    SELECT 
        "School Code",
        "School Name",
        "Enrollment (K-12)",
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)",
        ("Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)") AS FreeMealPercentage
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
        AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
)
SELECT 
    "School Code",
    "School Name",
    "Enrollment (K-12)",
    "Free Meal Count (K-12)",
    FreeMealPercentage,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY FreeMealPercentage) AS RankInCounty
FROM 
    FreeMealData
WHERE 
    FreeMealPercentage < 0.18;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.sname AS School,
        s.County,
        sc.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        satscores AS sc
    JOIN 
        schools AS s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 'F'
        AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    School,
    County,
    AvgScrRead
FROM 
    RankedSchools
WHERE 
    rank <= 5;

WITH SchoolData AS (
    SELECT s.cds, (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
           (s.NumTstTakr / s.enroll12) * 100 AS TestParticipationRate,
           s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.cds = '10621171030501'
),
DistrictData AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS DistrictAvgWriteScore
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s.dname = sch.District
    WHERE sch.CDSCode = '10621171030501'
),
RankingData AS (
    SELECT cds, (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS SATRank
    FROM satscores
)
SELECT sd.cds, sd.TotalSATScore, sd.TestParticipationRate, sd.AvgScrWrite,
       dd.DistrictAvgWriteScore, rd.SATRank
FROM SchoolData sd, DistrictData dd, RankingData rd
WHERE sd.cds = rd.cds;

WITH filtered_schools AS (

        "County Name",

WITH frpm_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "School Name",
        "District Name",
        "County Name",
        "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)",
        "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
        "Charter School (Y/N)",
        "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" AS FRPM_Percentage,
        CASE
            WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" >= 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
            WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 50 AND 74 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
            ELSE 'Low Poverty'
        END AS Poverty_Level
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" >= '9'
),
sat_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        sname,
        dname,
        cname,
        enroll12,
        NumTstTakr,
        AvgScrRead,
        AvgScrMath,
        AvgScrWrite,
        NumGE1500
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cds IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT CDSCode
        FROM frpm
        WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" >= '9'
    )
)
SELECT 
    f."School Name",
    f."District Name",
    f."County Name",
    f.FRPM_Percentage,
    f.Poverty_Level,
    f."Charter School (Y/N)",
    s.AvgScrRead,
    s.AvgScrMath,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    s.NumGE1500,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.FRPM_Percentage DESC) AS FRPM_Rank
FROM frpm_data f
JOIN sat_data s ON f."School Name" = s.sname;

        "Enrollment (K-12)",

WITH ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.County,
        sc.sname AS School,
        sc.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        satscores AS sc
    JOIN 
        schools AS s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 'F'
        AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    County,
    School,
    AvgScrRead
FROM 
    ranked_schools
WHERE 
    rank <= 5;

SELECT id, name,
       array_agg(DISTINCT replace(url, '"', '')) AS purchaseUrls
FROM (
    SELECT id, name,
           json_extract(replace(purchaseUrls, '''', '"'), '$.cardKingdom') AS cardKingdomUrl,
           json_extract(replace(purchaseUrls, '''', '"'), '$.cardKingdomFoil') AS cardKingdomFoilUrl
    FROM cards
    WHERE promoTypes LIKE '%bundle%'
) subquery
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cardKingdomUrl AS url
    WHERE cardKingdomUrl IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cardKingdomFoilUrl
    WHERE cardKingdomFoilUrl IS NOT NULL
) urls
GROUP BY id, name;

WITH badge_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Date) = 2010) AS student_badges_2010,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Date) = 2011) AS student_badges_2011,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Date) IN (2010, 2011)) AS total_student_badges
)
SELECT 
    (student_badges_2010 / total_student_badges * 100) - (student_badges_2011 / total_student_badges * 100) AS percentage_difference
FROM badge_counts;

    CZK_Consumption - EUR_Consumption AS ConsumptionDifference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT SUM(CAST(ym.Consumption AS DECIMAL(18, 6)))

         FROM yearmonth ym
         JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
         WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND LEFT(ym.Date, 4) = '2012') AS EUR_Consumption
) AS ConsumptionDifferences;

-- Step 1: Identify accounts with approved loans in 1997
WITH approved_loans_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id, amount
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'approved' AND date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
),

-- Step 2: Determine the lowest approved loan amount
lowest_amount AS (
    SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_amount
    FROM approved_loans_1997
),

-- Step 3: Filter accounts with the lowest approved loan amount
lowest_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM approved_loans_1997
    WHERE amount = (SELECT min_amount FROM lowest_amount)
),

-- Step 4: Further filter for weekly issuance
final_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM lowest_accounts a
    JOIN account ac ON a.account_id = ac.account_id
    WHERE ac.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)

-- Final result
SELECT account_id
FROM final_accounts;

sql:
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(CAST(ex.cost AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS parking_cost
    FROM expense ex
    JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE ex.expense_description LIKE '%Parking%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
) AS parking_costs ON e.event_id = parking_costs.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_name, parking_costs.parking_cost
HAVING parking_costs.parking_cost < (
    SELECT AVG(parking_cost) AS avg_parking_cost
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(CAST(ex.cost AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS parking_cost
        FROM expense ex
        JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
        WHERE ex.expense_description LIKE '%Parking%'
        GROUP BY b.link_to_event
    ) AS sub_parking_costs
);

  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_heroes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_heroes
  FROM superhero
  JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
  JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id

)

FROM marvel_heroes;

    (COUNT(carcinogenic.molecule_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(triple_bonded.molecule_id)) AS percentage_of_carcinogenic_molecules_with_triple_bonded_hydrogen
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    INNER JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    INNER JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#'
) AS triple_bonded

    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.label = '+'
) AS carcinogenic ON triple_bonded.molecule_id = carcinogenic.molecule_id;

sql:
WITH triple_bonded_hydrogen AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    INNER JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    INNER JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#'
),
carcinogenic_triple_bonded_hydrogen AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN triple_bonded_hydrogen tbh ON m.molecule_id = tbh.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(carcinogenic_triple_bonded_hydrogen.molecule_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(triple_bonded_hydrogen.molecule_id)) AS percentage_of_carcinogenic_molecules_with_triple_bonded_hydrogen
FROM 
    triple_bonded_hydrogen
INNER JOIN 
    carcinogenic_triple_bonded_hydrogen ON triple_bonded_hydrogen.molecule_id = carcinogenic_triple_bonded_hydrogen.molecule_id;
